name: First Solar
description: First Solar manufactures solar panels using its own cadmium telluride (CdTe) thin-film technology rather than the crystalline silicon used by most rivals, and sells them by the watt to utilities, developers and independent power producers, mainly under multi-year supply agreements. It describes itself as the largest US solar module maker and the only US-headquartered company among the world's largest manufacturers; 96% of 2025 net sales were in the United States. It sold 17.5 GW of modules in 2025 (16.1 GW produced), and a meaningful part of its profit comes from selling US Section 45X manufacturing tax credits for cash.

employees.note: Approximately 7,900 associates (full and part-time), mostly in the US, Malaysia, India and Vietnam; unions only in Vietnam and Sweden.

businessLines.name: Modules (single reportable segment)
businessLines.how: Sells CdTe thin-film modules priced per watt to utility-scale developers, independent power producers and utilities, mostly under multi-year supply agreements; profit is boosted by US Section 45X production tax credits (sold to third parties for cash) for US-made modules.
